statement: For n ≥ 3, an A-invariant, A-ergodic probability on SLn(Z)\ SLn(R) that has positive entropy for some diagonal one-parameter subgroup is the invariant probability on a closed finite-volume orbit xJ, where J is a closed connected subgroup containing A.
